simple.meaning: גֵּוָה (gêvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “exaltation ; (figuratively) arrogance.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גֵּוָה (H1466) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 22:29, with occurrences in Job, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֵּוָה (H1466) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גֵּוָה (H1466) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גֵּוָה (gêvâh) / H1466 is traced through Job 22:29, Job 33:17, Jeremiah 13:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
